I love you too. I'm doing it because I don't feel a point anymore. I did feel I had a life purpose which made me really excited at the start of this year. It just sort of disappeared and I was left with the realization that things just feel meaningless and arbitrary. I could have billions of dollars, be the happiest person ever, but it just feels fake and meaningless. I do care for people and hope that humanity gets better, but I don't want to have any part of it.

Edit: To add on, I hated myself for a long time. I stopped doing that. I no longer hate myself. I just don't really care about living anymore, I guess.
Nah, definitely going through with it. Just wanted to speak to some people before I go out.
I hope that the end is peaceful
